sentences.text:
And  In the matter of: Montu @ Rajsekhar Mondal  ....petitioner.
 Mr. Mrinal Kanti Mukherjee
Mr. Sandipan Ganguly  Mr. Amit Kumar Nag  Mr. M. Roy  Mr. Piyush Kumar Ray  ...for the de facto complainant.

1.
Heard learned Counsel for both the parties.

2. In the instant case the informant lodged the FIR to the effect that one Subrata De sold a peace of land to the informant claiming to be the owner of the said land wherein the petitioner signed as a confirming party.

Subsequently, it comes out that at that material time the said Subrata De had got no marketable title since the deed of conveyance in respect of the self-same land as executed by the present petitioner as vendor in favour of the said Subrata De (purchaser) remained incomplete on account of non-deposit of requisite stamp duties as submitted by learned Counsel for the petitioner.

3. The prayer for anticipatory bail was opposed on behalf of the State as well as on behalf on the informant on the ground that the present petitioner has duped the informant by suppressing the aforementioned information.

4. On perusal of the entire materials as placed before us, it prima facie appears to this Court that the relief of the parties with regard to the dispute as discussed above lies with the common law forum.

5. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation, nature of offence and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that Montu @ Rajsekhar Mondal vs Unknown on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142642798/
1

the petitioner shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of his arrest in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case including the conditions that:
i) The petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O.
once in a week on the day and time fixed by the I.O. for the purpose of investigation till submission of F.F.
ii) The petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of the P.S. without obtaining prior leave from the I.O. during investigation.
6. The concerned Arresting Officer is hereby directed to act upon the server copy of this order.
7.
Within 21 days from today the petitioner shall appear before the I.O. alongwith a server copy/certified copy of this order.
If server copy is supplied, learned I.O. shall act upon that.
8. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
9. The application being CRM (A) 3779 of 2023 is disposed of.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
